invitation_body: {{email}} accepted your invitation and created an account.
scan_aborted_body:
The scan of the library {{library}} was aborted; nothing was changed.

{{reason}}
root_content_changed_body: The folder {{path}} of the library {{library}} now reads {{to}} instead of {{from}}. As with a removal, {{items}} titles left the lists and {{files}} files are no longer registered; the scan creates the titles anew. Progress and watchlist entries stay with the old titles; their offline downloads on the devices are deleted.
root_removed_body: The folder {{path}} was removed from the library {{library}}. {{items}} titles left the lists with it and {{files}} files are no longer registered. Progress and watchlist entries stay with the titles; their offline downloads on the devices are deleted.
root_missing: A folder of the library is missing (disk or share not attached).
root_empty: A folder of the library is empty although files in it are known (not mounted?).
loss_over_threshold: More than 20 % of the known files would have disappeared. Administration › Libraries can accept the loss.
test_body: This message confirms that the channel {{channel}} works.
telegram_linked: Slouchcat: this chat is now linked to the account {{account}}.
update_rolled_back_body: The update from {{from}} to {{to}} failed. The updater started the old version again.
update_migrated: The database was migrated already, so the updater rolled nothing back.
update_migrated_backup: The database was migrated already, so the updater rolled nothing back. Only the backup {{backup}} leads back.
